children: Bank7 was named the successful bidder to acquire an approximately 71% controlling interest in Century for a $91.0 million purchase price (net ~ $89.0 million).
Bank7's final bid of $91.0M (including ~$2.0M breakup credit) was selected as the highest or best bid at the court-supervised auction.
The purchase contemplates acquisition of ~237,136 shares plus other receivership shares totaling about 71% ownership of Century.
Net cash purchase price is approximately $89.0M; sale conducted by a court-appointed receiver in a receivership proceeding.
Transaction remains subject to required bank regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions; expected to close in Q4.
Upon completion, combined Southwest organization would have roughly $3.4B in total assets based on disclosed Century balances.
